# SEOPage

> SEOPage (seopage.com) builds done-for-you SEO landing pages. You name the search you
> want to win; we research the results, write the page, structure it for search
> engines and AI assistants, review it by hand, and deliver one ready-to-publish
> HTML file. $99 per page, in your inbox within 3 hours. We also run a free,
> human-reviewed SEO page audit of a page you already have.

## Definitions

**What is an SEO landing page?** An SEO landing page is a web page engineered to win one
specific search. It targets a single keyword with a matching title tag, meta
description, heading structure, content written for the search intent, and
schema markup, so search engines can rank it and AI assistants can cite it.

**What is an SEO page audit?** An SEO page audit is a review of one web page
against the specific search it is trying to win: whether it matches the intent
behind the query, whether it covers what the ranking pages cover, whether the
title tag, meta description, headings, URL, and schema are correct, and whether
search engines and AI assistants can crawl, understand, and quote it. A site
audit looks at hundreds of pages shallowly; a page audit looks at one page
properly.

**What is on-page SEO?** On-page SEO covers the elements that live on the page
itself: content, title tag, meta description, headings, internal links, images,
URL structure, and structured data. Off-page SEO covers signals from other
sites, chiefly backlinks.

## Services

- **Done-for-you SEO page** — $99 per page, one-time, no subscription.
  Delivered within 3 hours as a single self-contained HTML file that is yours
  forever. Includes search-intent research, competitor analysis, a
  keyword-focused title tag and meta description, H1–H3 structure, the full
  written page, an FAQ section written to be quoted, schema markup,
  internal-link recommendations, an llms.txt file, an AI-crawler access check,
  and human review by the founder. Revise-or-refund guarantee.
- **Free SEO page audit** — one page, one target search, reviewed by a person,
  emailed within 24 hours. No account, no card. 29 checks across search intent,
  the elements search engines read, the content, AI citation readiness, and
  technical fundamentals.

## Approach

- Pages are built for two surfaces at once: ranking on Google, and being quoted
  by AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Claude).
- What earns an AI citation: self-contained passages that still make sense
  lifted out of the page, specific checkable facts rather than adjectives, an
  FAQ block with matching FAQPage structured data, clear entity markup, and a
  robots.txt that does not block GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, or
  Google-Extended.
- On llms.txt specifically: we ship one with every page because it costs
  nothing, but as of 2026 no major AI company has committed to reading llms.txt
  in production, and Google's own guidance says it is not used for AI Overviews
  or AI Mode. Anyone selling llms.txt as the reason you will get cited is
  overselling it.
- Every page is reviewed by Zev Uhuru, who has built landing pages
  professionally for over a decade for vroom.com, fubo.tv, and esy.com.
